title: Intrinsically complete derived full subcategory
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $d=(A,I)$ a Noetherian adic coefficient datum with finite perfect positive quotients, and $D_X=D(\operatorname{Mod}(A_X))$ its completed-coefficient derived category [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. Fix any finite generating tuple $a:\operatorname{Fin}(r)\to A$ for $I$, allowing $r=0$. For $K\in D_X$, use the complex $C_K$ and isomorphism $Q(C_K)\simeq K$ supplied by essential surjectivity of the derived localization. Define $\operatorname{Complete}_{X,d,a}(K)$ to mean that the intrinsic Koszul completion unit of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion], computed on this representative and transported to $K$, is invertible. Define $D_X^{\mathrm{comp}}$ to be the full subcategory of $D_X$ cut out by this predicate, with the same morphisms, addition and scalar actions as the ambient category. Its objects carry only the completeness proposition, not a chosen completion witness.
